text:
The trial court should overrule the company's objection and admit the deposition testimony as former testimony of an unavailable witness under FRE 804(b)(1). The team note is mistaken: the company was the defendant in the engineer's wrongful termination suit, and its own attorney took the deposition. So the company had both the opportunity and a similar motive to examine him on whether it filed false safety reports. The pilot need not have been a party to the earlier case, because the rule only requires that the party against whom the testimony is offered had that opportunity and motive.

CONFIDENCE: 82
